description:
About the company
 Our client is a healthcare technology company.
 The role
 Raydar is recruiting for this role on behalf of our client. Take ownership of an AI-driven dialogue platform end to end, from inheriting current systems to designing a new one. The work centers on evaluation and monitoring, keeping methods up to date, and close coordination with operations and engineering colleagues.
 What you'll do
 - Inherit and run the current AI-driven dialogue systems used by people outside the company.
 - Create a new automated assistant that will operate alongside the existing systems.
 - Set up evaluation and monitoring practices that surface problems before they reach users.
 - Keep these systems current with recent developments in the field.
 - Work closely with operations and engineering colleagues.
 Requirements 
 What we're looking for
 - Prior work shipping a dialogue-driven AI product that a large, recurring audience relies on.
 - Hands-on history of diagnosing production breakdowns in an AI system and putting evaluation and tracing in place to stop them recurring.
 - Deep, hands-on expertise in building AI agents.
 - Zero to four years of professional experience.
 Benefits 
 Compensation and benefits
 - Base salary: USD 150,000 to 220,000 per year
 - Retirement plan
 Location and work model
 - San Francisco, California, United States
 - On-site, in person, 6 days a week
 - Full-time
